data.body: PARALLEL PLAN-REVIEW WAVE 1 results: 271c PASS+signed, e59d-3418 PASS+signed (both 708d roots, now claimable). ea28 (8fc2 root) BLOCK on 2 findings that were one gap - rubric front-matter spec omitted title:, and build_descriptor computes name = prompt.title or cid, so the criterion name would degrade to the bare id T15 and AC#4 (rebar explain T15 prints the criterion name) would pass only degenerately; fixed by pinning title + the rationale, re-review running. f161 round 5 = BLOCK with 4 findings, ALL self-inflicted by the round-4 instrument-field edit: (1) E1/COH Approach-1 and AC-1 still said THREE fields while 1a said four; (2) G6 AC-5's instrument-vs-authorization judgement had NO mechanism assigned; (3) G6 I wrote 'at 1-TURN it would have no filesystem tooling', contradicting what I had already verified - tooling is granted by the PROMPT's execution_mode, not the routing exec tier - and mis-cited project.engine-layer-enforcement as an AGENT precedent when it is exec 1-TURN; (4) T8 rule (d) not co-located in the rubric spec. Remediated coherently: four fields everywhere, the two knobs separated (exec AGENT = agent loop, execution_mode agentic = tool grant, BOTH required), precedent re-scoped to the trigger mechanism only, and an explicit DET-vs-AGENT ownership split with rule (d) named as the escape-2b mechanism. Round 6 running.
